tagline: Jev triages thousands of made-up inbox messages live: fast, cheap, measured

examples.prompt: Turn the desk into player support for a made-up game studio. Write 8 teams with sharp descriptions and at least 6 phrases each. Then find the lowest threshold that keeps auto-routing above 95% right at noise 0.3, and tell me how many messages it escalates.
examples.caption: A new desk designed by the agent, with a measured threshold

examples.prompt: Make it hard. Set noise to 0.7 and tell me what happens to accuracy and escalations, which two teams get mixed up most, and which threshold you would pick.
examples.caption: Turn the noise dial and read the trade-off on synthetic data
